qa_pair.question: Create a pendulum in headless mode with model_id 'test_pendulum'. Step the simulation exactly 250 times. What is the simulation time (in seconds) after these steps? Round to 3 decimal places.
Create a double_pendulum simulation. Without stepping, get the initial state and count how many degrees of freedom (nq) the system has.
Create a cart_pole in headless mode. Check the initial state - how many joint positions (length of qpos array) does the cart_pole system have?
Create a pendulum, step it 100 times, then reset it. After resetting, what is the simulation time?
Get server info and list all the capabilities. How many capabilities are listed in the capabilities array?
Create an arm simulation in headless mode. Get the state in concise format. What is the value of the 'nq' field in the concise response?

Create a pendulum with custom model_id 'physics_test_01', step it 50 times. Then create another pendulum with model_id 'physics_test_02', don't step it. Get the state of 'physics_test_02' - what is its simulation time?
Create a double_pendulum. Step it exactly 500 steps. Get the state in detailed format. What is the simulation time rounded to 2 decimal places?
Check the server protocol_version from server info. What is the exact protocol version string?
Create a cart_pole simulation. Get its initial state and check the 'statistics' field. What is the value of 'nu' (number of actuators)?
